comparisons.topic: Disjunct relations can receive different source-native treatment

ptolemy.claim: Disjunct/opposite relevant natal signs signify deepest enmities.

rhetorius.claim: Specific disjunct pairs have sympathy through equal rising, equal power or like zone; text expressly links method to human relationships.

comparisons.operational_consequence: Keep Rhetorius exceptions in his profile. Do not silently insert them into Ptolemy or claim direct empirical disproof of either. This is a bounded textual comparison.

comparisons.topic: Square relation versus sympathetic square exceptions

ptolemy.claim: In the remaining aspect-only branch squares produce lesser antipathies.

rhetorius.claim: Six named square pairs are sympathetic via equal rising/equal power/like zone; other squares ineffective in sympathy.

comparisons.operational_consequence: No universal hard-aspect-equals-enmity weight. Geometric90degrees stays the same; claimed sympathetic qualification differs. Neither is a separate observation.

comparisons.topic: Travel-topic entry point and benefic conditions

ptolemy.claim: Start with luminaries relative to angles; use topical rulers and modifying testimony.

rhetorius.claim: Good stars in ninth signify fortune abroad; especially with well-placed domicile/exaltation ruler unregarded by malefics. Mercury has a further qualified ninth-house rule.

comparisons.operational_consequence: Ninth-house delineation is not a substitute for Ptolemy’s broader angular/cadent method. Preserve Rhetorius’s place/ruler/phase qualifiers; no claim of an additional successful prediction.
